You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From e81e6ad05bebea3ee6f43835764ff75cb10743a7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Federico Cerisola <federico@cerisola.net>
Date: Sat, 3 Jun 2017 22:40:13 -0300
Subject: [PATCH] Fixed bug in calculation of average values

This fixes a bug introduced in 2c252fea46496b127317b79c04e1dce3aa9dd54b when
calculating averages of the thermodynamic quantities.
---
 src/ising_temperature_sweep.c | 2 --
 1 file changed, 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/ising_temperature_sweep.c b/src/ising_temperature_sweep.c
index d9706e0..cfe5c27 100644
--- a/src/ising_temperature_sweep.c
+++ b/src/ising_temperature_sweep.c
@@ -85,8 +85,6 @@ int main(int argc, char ** argv)
                 update_online_mean_variance(quantities.E, j / nsep, Eavg + i, Evar + i);
             }
         }
-        Mavg[i] /= nsamples;
-        Eavg[i] /= nsamples;
         Mvar[i] /= nsamples - 1;
         Evar[i] /= nsamples - 1;
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect averaging of the magnetization (Mavg) and energy (Eavg) values, where the division by the number of samples (nsamples) was mistakenly included in the code, leading to an incorrect calculation of the average values for these thermodynamic quantities. The patch removed this erroneous division, which was likely introduced in a previous commit, ensuring that the averages are calculated correctly.
